method.tables: Every gold model and every seed a gold table refers to. Tables not built in the local warehouse take their columns and keys from dbt.
method.keys: A primary key is the smallest set of key-like columns whose values are unique and never empty in the data.
method.relations: A table refers to another when it holds that table's whole primary key and at least 90 % of its distinct values exist there. Coverage is the measured share.
method.party: Party is a code shared by many tables; no table lists the parties.
